## About
LeBon Chiropractic Health Center has long served The Woodlands area with consistent quality chiropractic care using the gentle Activator Method Technique. Our patients enjoy a personalized experience and receive a thorough assessment on every visit.
Dr. Brent Steck grew up in Montgomery, TX, and first came to this office through an internship with Dr. Le Bon. He earned his Doctorate of Chiropractic Degree at Parker College of Chiropractic in Dallas, holds an Advanced Proficiency Rating from Activator Methods, International, and is also a licensed Acupuncturist.
Patients have given us a 5 rating from 33 Google reviews. One reviewer said simply, "This is one doctor's appointment I don't mind coming too."

## Services
- Low force Activator Method Chiropractic Care: Dr. Steck uses the Activator Adjusting Instrument to deliver specific low force adjustments to the spine and extremities, restoring proper alignment and function to joints and their associated soft tissues.
- Traditional Needle Acupuncture and Electro-Acupuncture: Acupuncture is generally performed with very small disposable needles. Electro-acupuncture does not use needles, but achieves the same results.
- Foot Levelers Orthotics: Using the Foot Levelers system, orthotics are custom made from a scan of your feet to support them exactly as needed, which can help your knees, hips and spine as well.
- Cold Laser Therapy: Low level laser therapy for soft tissue injuries, working at the cellular level to help repair tissue and ease pain.
- Nutritional Counseling: The doctor will help you lay out a plan for success with your nutrition goals.
- Vitamins and Supplements: We keep an assortment of vitamins, herbal supplements and homeopathic medicines, and the doctor may recommend products based on your needs.

## FAQ
Q: Are you in network with my plan?
A: We are in network providers for Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Humana, United Health Care and Medicare. We submit claims for other out of network plans as well.

Q: What happens at my first visit?
A: All new patients receive a thorough orthopedic and neurological examination before any treatment begins.

Q: Can I talk with someone before booking?
A: Yes. Free 10 minute consultations are available if you have questions.

Q: Is there acupuncture without needles?
A: Yes. Electro-acupuncture does not use needles, but achieves the same results.
